headline: 2 of 3 themes are honest zeros. One survivor (S6_SKEW_TILT|day, an options order-flow imbalance book on 49 liquid single names) clears the pooled 102-formula bar on both nulls and is held-out net positive at every realistic rail. PROPOSAL ONLY: basket stays frozen at v9; S6 queues for a size-zero forward paper log with a named kill guard.

pooled_null.construction: No cross-theme permutation is constructible (disjoint instruments, clocks, statistics). Each theme ran its own size-matched null; the pooled bar scales theme 1's ADV-slot signal permutation (2000 draws, one permutation shared per (draw,day) to preserve cross-formula correlation) from N=48 to N=102 by the exact analytic ratio 3.479/3.272 = 1.063.
pooled_null.ratio_ledger: 1.08x disjoint auction book (0822B); ~2x overlapping weekly CEF pair book (0822); 1.14x disjoint event book (0822C); 0.845x CEF fund-identity permutation; 1.061x this round (one-session-hold cross-sectional book). Inflation tracks HOLDING OVERLAP, not multiplicity.

survivors.mechanism_as_named: Gamma-weighted OTM call-vs-put open-interest tilt, cross-sectionally rank-normalised over 49 liquid single names, dollar-neutral long-top/short-bottom, entered at the OPEN of t+1 and exited at the OPEN of t+2.
survivors.mechanism_as_diagnosed: OPTIONS ORDER-FLOW IMBALANCE in liquid single names. The Black-Scholes apparatus contributes nothing: a crude greeks-free (callVol-putVol)/(callVol+putVol) does as well in design (3.68) and better out of sample (4.32). |net gamma| vs next-session realised range is weakly POSITIVE (+0.094/+0.035). All pin, flip and charm/vanna cells are noise. NOT a dealer-gamma effect.
survivors.shared_print_note: Signal at close of t, fill at open of t+1: >=17.5h gap, signal and fill never share a print.
survivors.rho1_gate: not applicable - not a spread trade; pre-registered substitute is the one-day-gap re-entry placebo, scored +3.35 vs primary +3.58. Gate has teeth: G4_DGEX1|day cleared the analytic bar (t 3.32) and was killed by it (+3.08 -> -0.23).
survivors.diversification_argument: None of T3, DUALCLASS, T12 CEF or ORB reads an option feed. Market beta 0.036; residualised on r1/r5/r20 the Sharpe RISES to 4.03; no CEF in the universe is optionable; S6 holds open-to-open with no intraday leg.
survivors.recommendation: QUEUE - forward paper log at size ZERO. Basket frozen at v9; no exception.
reasons_not_to_size: Only 260 held-out sessions (free expired OPRA starts 2024-02-01, 2.5 years total).
The stated mechanism is wrong - out-of-sample decay is unbounded even when the statistic is sound.
Standing programme prior: selection-inflated estimates are upper bounds; +2.92 net is a ceiling.
guard: Forward paper log, size ZERO, minimum 60 sessions before promotion is reopened.
Kill if forward gross Sharpe < 0 over any trailing 60 sessions, OR net@3.0bp Sharpe < +1.0 over the full forward log, OR the one-day-gap re-entry placebo drops below +2.0.
Kill if the single-names-only sub-book decays below +1.5. Exclude the sector-ETF half from the traded book from day one (held-out 0.55, net -0.01) - do not re-include for breadth.

Data-continuity guard: monthly expiries only, weeklies/0DTE absent, cumulative traded volume is an OI PROXY not open interest. Monthly coverage check; a feed change or expiry-calendar shift VOIDS the log rather than degrades it (cf. XS_GLSR_Z).
Pre-register the crude greeks-free (callVol-putVol)/(callVol+putVol) book as a competing forward log from the same start date. If it matches or beats S6, the crude book is the promotion candidate.
Any strike-grid refetch must re-run the shipped fine+coarse grid union and diff strike counts against the cached panel (two grid bugs were caught pre-result).
survivors.biggest_open_risk: Cross-sectionally orthogonalising the S6 SIGNAL on IV + 20d RV cuts held-out Sharpe 3.58 -> 0.95. That strips the vol ORDERING out of the signal (S6 is legitimately +0.25..+0.29 vol-correlated because high-vol names carry more OTM call OI) rather than hedging the vol BOOKS, and is the wrong exposure test - the spanning regression is the right one and IV/RV loadings are statistically zero. Reported in full because it is the single most likely place S6 turns out to be a repackaged vol exposure.

one_place_survivor_fails.why_not_like_for_like: That null is inflated by four n=77 OpEx cells whose Sharpe has a much fatter null than an n~350 cell. Comparing an n=350 Sharpe to a bar set by n=77 cells is not like-for-like. The t comparison is the correct one (t is n-normalised): 4.53 vs 3.691, clears. Both stated so a reader who ran only the Sharpe null does not conclude the opposite.

carry_forward_rules: Use the EXACT best-of-N bar, not sqrt(2 ln N). At N=102 the approximation says 3.041 and the truth is 3.479 - a 13% understatement, the difference between a survivor and a false positive.
Run permutation nulls on GROSS. A net-series permutation null is mis-specified: the permuted book pays full cost, the null sits below zero, everything 'wins'.

A clean rho1 on the spread does NOT clear the book. If the signal is built from a single own-print close, run the entry-lag decay test (lags 0/1/2). Theme 3's catch-up family passed rho1 (0/41 fail) and died on lag decay (+0.83/+0.33/-0.07).
Placebo/analytic ratio tracks holding overlap, not multiplicity. One-session hold -> 1.06x; overlapping weekly book -> ~2x.
The dead pool being the MORE liquid one is evidence for, not against: theme 1's sector ETFs died while single names lived - the opposite of the illiquidity-artefact signature.
Free 5-minute bars carry no recoverable order-flow information about the rest of the session.
The Aug-20 intraday-RV gross edge was made of exactly two things: a minutes-long hold and a fill sharing the signal print. Remove both and it vanishes.
